caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cradle with curved and wavy edges, standing on two rocking legs. Inside the cradle, there is a doll lying on its back, covered by a yellow blanket with a pattern of blue lines forming a grid. The doll has a round, pale face with black hair and is wearing a peach-colored dress with a white collar and yellow trim around the neck. The doll’s head rests on a pale pink or beige pillow. The wood grain and knots on the cradle are visible, rendered in brown tones with lighter highlights and some small white marks. The entire scene sits within a lightly sketched rectangular border. The drawing is executed in a realistic style with subdued, naturalistic colors.
title: Pa. German Cradle with Doll & Coverlet
